time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0
view: near-nadir (top-down) drone view of a multi-lane highway; traffic flows left -> right along +x; lanes run horizontally

camera.note: phase correlation vs frame 0: drift < 0.6 px in x and < 2 px in y over the clip (negligible); see camera_shift.csv
camera.perspective: near-orthographic top-down; lane-divider spacing is ~306-330 px everywhere, dashes ~293-304 px long across the full width, so one px scale applies (planar). Car apparent sizes are constant along the track (template match residual stays small).

red_pickup.description: red pickup truck with grey tonneau (bed) cover, lane 4 from top (between dash rows y~989 and y~1310), drifts steadily downward in the image (towards / onto the divider at y~1310, i.e. a slow lane change towards the lane of silver_pickup); casts the large shadow to its upper-left

gray_sedan.description: blue-grey sedan in the top lane (y~180) at the start, ahead (right) of the others; leaves through the right edge

white_car.description: white / silver-white sedan with dark sunroof in the top lane (y~150-190); enters from the left edge at frame 7, behind gray_sedan

silver_pickup.description: pickup truck with silver/light-grey cab and black bed cover, lane 5 (between dash rows y~1310 and y~1616), enters from the left edge at frame 20

dark_car.description: dark charcoal sedan in the top lane (y~145-156), enters from the left edge at frame 27, behind white_car; heavy motion blur

lane_dashes.description: white dashed lane dividers, 6 rows, see static_markings.json for every dash
lane_dashes.note: rows slope slightly (y grows ~+8..+17 px from left to right edge)

top_solid_lines.description: two continuous white lines along the top edge (road edge / barrier), full width

top_lane.description: lane between top solid line (y~76) and first dash row (y~355): width ~280 px; gray_sedan, white_car, dark_car use it

raised_markers.description: small white raised pavement markers between dashes on each divider row (a few px)

road_stains.description: dark oil stains near x 80-260, y 920-950 (left edge, lane 3)

events.event: front bumper crosses left image edge (car enters; extrapolated)
front bumper crosses right image edge (car starts leaving)
rear bumper crosses left image edge (car fully in view)
rear bumper reaches right image edge (car gone); extrapolated from frames 0-12
front bumper crosses left image edge (car enters; extrapolated)
rear bumper crosses left image edge (car fully in view)
front bumper crosses left image edge (car enters; extrapolated)
front bumper crosses right image edge (car starts leaving)
rear bumper crosses left image edge (car fully in view)
rear bumper reaches right image edge (car gone); extrapolated, frame 34 shows only a ~40 px sliver of its tail
no starts/stops, contacts, collisions or reversals; every vehicle moves continuously rightward for the whole clip
